subtitle: Incident Request Form: construction incident stabilization and fact record using people involved, immediate care, and firsthand statements.
title: Incident Request Form
use_case: Use the request form during construction incident stabilization and fact record when the incident record must identify people involved, exact location, activity, equipment, witnesses, environmental conditions, and emergency response. Complete the applicable handoff for qualified review, required notifications, corrective actions, return-to-work authority, and record retention.
